admission.justification: Spans user settings and repository layers: plaintext notes are user-authorized, repository layers cannot author them, and permission-bearing or unknown-bearing values are refused — the authorization boundary FAM-N17BB4's guarantee assumes.

applicability: Every settings layer that could carry mode text, role notes, permissions or feature values.
conditions: The value is permission-bearing, unknown-bearing, or a mode/role note.
exclusions: User-authorized mode and role notes, which repositories cannot author but users can.
statement: Mode and role plaintext notes are user-authorized settings; repository layers cannot author them, and repository permission-bearing or unknown-bearing feature values are refused.
